subject: general
title: Unit 4 Heredity
textbookText: Circle the correct alternative of the following questions.
1 How many pairs of sex chromosomes are found in the human cell?
2. What is a chromosome made up of?
3. What is the smallest unit of the chromosome that helps in the transmission of hereditary characteristics?
4. A technician working in a radiotherapy laboratory was tested after a long time of marriage when there was no childbirth.
After the test, it was found that his child production capacity was reduced because he worked in high-intensity radiation for a
long time. Which part of the cell affected in this case?
5. If a nucleotide is destructed during DNA replication, what happens to the organism?
ii) It brings a problem in cell division
iii) it brings a problem in reproduction
iv) The chromosome does not function
6. Which of the following indicates the set of chromosomes in a cell of a woman?
7. Which of the following statements is true?
i) Ovum contains only a Y chromosome and sperm contains an X chromosome
ii) Ovum contains only an X chromosome and sperm contains a Y chromosome
iii) Ovum contains only an X chromosome and sperm contains either an X or Y chromosome
iv) Ovum and sperm both contain X and Y-chromosomes.
Ans:- iii) Ovum contains only an X chromosome and sperm contains either an X or Y chromosome
8. Which of the following is the genotypic ratio for Monohybrid cross?
9. A white-skinned child was born from a dark-skinned parent. What is the reason for this?
ii) Both the father and mother have pure black characters.
Ans:- i) The parent was hybrid
10. Ramit has produced a new plant by crossing an orange plant and a lemon plant. What type of plant is this?
i) Advanced variety ii) plant Pure plant
11. Roshani is a student from Himalayan region. A mule is reared in her home for transportation of the goods. But the mule is
getting older, and her family members are considering getting a new mule. In this situation, she asked her father how a mule
give birth to a child. Which of the following is the correct answer given by her father?
ii) There is inbreeding in mule
iii) Mule cannot produce offspring naturally
iv) Mules produce offspring by artificial method.
Ans:- iii) Mule cannot produce offspring naturally
1. What is gene? Where is located?
Ans:- Gene is the unit of heredity that controls a character. It is located on the chromosome.
2. How many pair of chromosomes are found in frog and gorilla cell?
Ans:- 13 pairs (26) and 24 pairs (48) of chromosomes are found in frog and gorilla cell respectively.
